WEBSITE PRIVACY · OCTOBER 13, 2026

A clear view.
Of your privacy.

What this website does, what stays on this page, and where the native app is a separate responsibility.

No advertising pixels. No microphone recording. No child account in this preview.

01

What the demo does.

The interactive preview uses prepared questions, answers, a story and a math sample. It does not record your microphone, collect a child’s name or date of birth, open a live AI chat, or create a real child profile.

Your sample settings and completed demo activities are held in this page’s memory. They reset when the page reloads. The demo does not use cookies or browser storage to retain them.

02

Motion is your choice.

Reduced-motion settings on your device are respected automatically. If you turn motion off here, that choice is carried in this site’s page URLs so it follows you between pages. This uses no browser storage and does not preserve demo activity or child information.

03

What happens when you visit.

Your browser requests website files, images and recordings from the hosting infrastructure. That infrastructure can process ordinary request information such as IP address, browser information, timestamps and technical logs to deliver and protect the service. We therefore do not describe this website as collecting “no data.”

The website code contains no advertising pixels, analytics scripts, third-party fonts, embedded video players or behavior-tracking code. Recordings are fetched only when needed for playback. A private preview may also be subject to its hosting platform’s sign-in and privacy practices.

04

When you contact us.

Email links open your email app. Nothing is submitted to a waitlist or mailing list by clicking them. If you choose to send a message, your email provider and the recipient’s email service process it. Please contact us as an adult, and do not include a child’s recordings, sensitive details or identifying information.

Contact: jrtrustin@gmail.com. You may use this address to ask about a message you have sent or request its deletion. This website does not offer an account to delete.

05

The native app is separate.

This notice does not describe or authorize collection in the native TrustinJr app. Before a public child-facing release, app-specific collection and uses, providers, retention, appropriate consent and parent rights—including deletion—need to be described and verified separately. The absence of advertising or microphone capture in this demo does not establish the native app’s data practices or regulatory compliance. See what is available and what remains in testing.

06

Links and changes.

Research links take you to other organizations’ websites, whose own policies apply. If data handling changes, this notice should be updated before introducing the change.
